# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `engine` MCP server pointing at Engine's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.engine.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Engine sign-in (`login.engine.com`, scope `mcp:invoke`).
- Logo: Engine's official app icon, the 256×256 web clip published on engine.com.
